question: Does the Android/Wear owner want to accept this focused TalkBack-label repair after the pending Wear checks and a lightweight accessibility verification?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and member authorship require explicit maintainer handling even though the diff is small and plausible.

options.title: Review and merge after accessibility check
